previous_statement: Uniform incompatible-corner product estimate. Let U in M_n tensor S_{P_j,P_k} and V in M_n tensor S_{P_l,P_m}, with k!=l. Since compression fixes its image and is within c_c e (for the universal constant in def-compressed-corner) of each parenthesized left-right multiplication, ||U-(p_j U)p_k||<=c_c e||U|| and ||V-p_l(V p_m)||<=c_c e||V||. Put A=p_j U and B=V p_m. The preceding projection bound and the product-norm axiom bound ||A||,||B||,||(A p_k)|| by universal multiples of ||U||,||V||. Replacing U,V by (A p_k),p_l B thus changes UV by O(e)||U||||V||. Twice applying the epsilon-associator gives (A p_k)(p_l B)=A((p_k p_l)B)+R, where ||R|| is at most a universal multiple of epsilon||U||||V||. The product-norm axiom and ||p_k p_l||<=4e bound the displayed main term by a universal multiple of e||U||||V||. Hence ||UV||<=K_inc e||U||||V||, with K_inc universal and independent of n.
new_statement: Uniform incompatible-corner product estimate. Let c_c be the universal constant in the two compression-versus-left/right-multiplication estimates of def-compressed-corner, fix e<=1/4, and take U in M_n tensor S_{P_j,P_k}, V in M_n tensor S_{P_l,P_m} with k!=l. Write s=1+epsilon<=5/4, A=p_j U, B=V p_m, U'=(A p_k), V'=p_l B. Because compression fixes U,V, ||U-U'||<=c_c e||U|| and ||V-V'||<=c_c e||V||. From ||p_i||<=2 and the product-norm axiom, ||A||<=5||U||/2, ||B||<=5||V||/2, ||U'||,||V'||<=25||U||/4,25||V||/4. Thus ||UV-U'V'||<=s c_c e||U||||V||+s||U'||c_c e||V||<=10c_c e||U||||V||. The associator axiom gives ||U'V'-A(p_k(p_lB))||<=epsilon||A||||p_k||||p_lB||<=125epsilon||U||||V||/4 and ||A(p_k(p_lB))-A((p_kp_l)B)||<=s||A||epsilon||p_k||||p_l||||B||<=125epsilon||U||||V||/4. Finally, ||A((p_kp_l)B)||<=s^2||A||||p_kp_l||||B||<=625e||U||||V||/16, using ||p_kp_l||<=4e. Since epsilon<=e, summing yields ||UV||<=(10c_c+102)e||U||||V||. This K_inc is universal and independent of n.
